searchText: <@586161934425128960> regarding forkchoice. The spec keeps an `Optional[boolean]` which PRysm will not ever be able to have the necessary information to recreate. We will only keep a bitlist and a count of how many votes were cast which is enough to recover the sum which is what's needed for `should_build_on_full`. So the Endpoint I suggest it returns a bitlist and the count for the PTC votes or something equivalent to that information but not more is that acceptable? hmmm, nevermind, perhaps we need to byte the bullet 🙁 <@881905303011086387> is there a spec for serialization of Optional? there is a spec for this, we have it in our ssz lib but the `GET /eth/v1/debug/fork_choice` already can't support ssz, it's json only, is the plan to extend that endpoint? I want to implement something for that endpoint, currently we will keep three bitlists: (voted, timeliness, da). I believe this is overkill for this endpoint, so I propose the endpoint returns for each node simply the number of votes, number of votes for timely and number of votes for available. This is enough to recover all needed information and it adds just 3 numbers per node and only in the pending nodes last time to decide if having the per-index data is useful or not. I'm leaning not cc <@575994543527297055> as you noted before that you wanna look into extend our fork choice endpoint <@586161934425128960> going with this for now https://github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/pull/16862 Can you look at the format? if that's fine I'll open a PR in the APIs why are you exposing `yes` count only? I would think the `no` count is more interesting, or otherwise let's say we have 255 `yes`, but how would be know if 257 was `no`, or if we had missed votes? I am exposing the total count as well that's the minimum info to recover the total count yes/nay ah overlooked that, that's fine then
